description: This file contains unit tests for the `AnyCodable` type, verifying its JSON encoding and decoding behavior, especially concerning Boolean values.

classes.name: RequestEnvelope
classes.description: A Codable struct used to encapsulate parameters with type `[String: AnyCodable]` in test scenarios.

methods.name: encodesNSNumberBooleansAsJSONBooleans
methods.description: Tests whether `NSNumber` booleans are correctly encoded as JSON booleans.

methods.name: preservesBooleanLiteralsFromJSONSerializationBridge
methods.description: Ensures that boolean literals are preserved correctly from JSON deserialization through `AnyCodable` encoding.
